column1: # Fleet suite timings, one row per suite per recorded run.
# run prints its timings and writes nothing, so this file is a series of
# measurements somebody meant to take rather than a log of every push.
# seconds covers the SUITE only — clone, npm install and build are
# excluded, being dominated by the network and by whatever npm had
# cached. What is left is the part an engine change can move.
# COMPARE ROWS FROM THE SAME host AND toolchain, AND PREFER RUNS TAKEN
# BACK TO BACK. These are wall-clock times on whatever machine ran them;
# across machines, or across a busy and an idle one, the difference
# between two rows says more about the machine than about the engine.
# ci/bench/ab-compare.sh is the instrument for deciding whether a
# performance change is real; this file is for noticing that something
# has become slow, not for proving by how much.
